title: AwesomeStudioPedal Standard Pin Names (v1)
description: Curated vocabulary of role-based pin names used by hardware-config and profile schemas. EPIC-029 / TASK-377. Single source of truth — schemas reference this file via $ref; firmware / app / docs read from this JSON. Lowercase snake_case, ≤30 names for v1. Additions go through the GitHub-idea process (TASK-382).

action_buttons.description: Momentary action buttons. The default build wires four (button_a … button_d). Builds with fewer buttons leave the unused names unmapped; builds with more wire button_e … button_h. Firmware currently supports up to 26 buttons; the v1 standard set covers the first eight (the practical maximum for a desk pedal).

profile_controls.description: Buttons that change which profile is active.

names.name: button_select
names.role: Cycles the active profile. Maps to the firmware buttonSelect pin.

status_leds.description: Single-pin status indicators driven by the firmware.

names.name: led_power
names.role: Firmware-controlled status LED: boot mismatch, DelayedAction countdown, config-load-error fallback. Maps to the firmware ledPower pin.

names.name: led_bluetooth
names.role: BLE connection indicator. Maps to the firmware ledBluetooth pin.

profile_select_leds.description: Profile-select LED array (one-hot or binary encoding, depending on numProfiles vs. numSelectLeds). Builds use a contiguous prefix of these names; firmware supports up to six. Maps to ledSelect[index-1] (one-based naming for builder readability).

names.name: led_select_1
names.role: Profile-select LED #1 (LSB in binary mode, profile 1 in one-hot mode).

names.name: led_select_6
names.role: Profile-select LED #6 (max — encoding ceiling at 2^6 − 1 = 63 profiles).

x-decisions.inventory: Roles inventoried from: data/config.json (ledBluetooth, ledPower, ledSelect[], buttonSelect, buttonPins[]); data/config.schema.json; data/profiles.json + profiles/{1,2,3,4}-button/*.json (button keys A/B/C/D and DelayedAction power-LED blink references); docs/builders/HARDWARE_CONFIG.md (ledPower semantics, ledSelect encoding modes); docs/builders/BUILD_GUIDE.md (default wiring table — 'Button: A/B/C/D', 'LED: Profile select 1/2/3', 'LED: Bluetooth status', 'LED: Status').
x-decisions.rejected_names: Names from IDEA-061 prose that are NOT in the v1 set: 'pedal_a' (not currently distinguished from action buttons — collapsed into button_a), 'expression_1' (no analog/expression-pedal support in firmware today), 'bank_up' / 'bank_down' (no bank-switching feature exists; button_select cycles profiles linearly). These can be added later via the TASK-382 process when the underlying feature ships.
x-decisions.home: Single JSON Schema file at data/pin-names.schema.json with enum + x-categories metadata. Chosen over (a) inlining enum into both schemas (duplication), (b) plain JSON/YAML data file (loses schema-validator integration). Downstream consumers: data/config.schema.json (TASK-378) references via $ref for the pinNames mapping values; data/profiles.schema.json (TASK-379) references via $ref for named-pin references inside actions; firmware (TASK-380), Flutter app + JS configurator (TASK-381) read the same JSON to drive autocomplete/validation. The x-categories block is metadata (JSON Schema ignores x-* keys) — UI tooling parses it for grouped autocomplete and human-readable descriptions.
x-decisions.naming_convention: Lowercase snake_case. Underscore separates role tokens (button_select, led_power). Numeric suffixes use _N (led_select_1, not led_select1) for one-based human-friendly indexing in the UI.
x-decisions.addition_process: Builders who need a role not in this v1 set file a GitHub idea proposing the addition (see docs/builders/HARDWARE_CONFIG.md once TASK-382 lands). Unknown names produce a warning, not a schema-validation error — local experimentation works; community sharing waits for the addition to land.
